narrative: Material PL1__ME4BA165 exhibits erratic but largely continuous demand (CV=0.443, 98.9% non-zero days) averaging 377 units/day across 88 working days. Lead times are bimodal (clustering ~2.1 and ~4.2 days) but temporally stable, yielding a mean of 2.79 days. The current SAP safety stock of 79 units is critically insufficient for a 95% service level; the model-recommended 780 units (robust sigma-LTD method) corrects this. An (r,Q) continuous-review policy with EOQ-scaled order quantity of 4,670 units reduces total annual inventory cost by 69% while satisfying the storage capacity constraint.
